reserveReview.reviewer: GLM issue-sweep 2026-09-29 (WithheldFallbackCircle) — fallback-composition reconciliation to the July 2026 USDtb reserve report (Deloitte & Touche LLP examination via Anchorage; report PDF read directly this pass)

sources.label: USDtb Reserve Report - July 2026 (Deloitte via Anchorage)

reserveReview.rationale: Rows keep the live usdtb-transparency adapter's two slice identities (adapter-owned source keys), with weights reconciled to Schedule II of the examination as of July 31, 2026: total reserve assets $401,718,132 vs $400,956,706 redeemable USDtb, composed of BUIDL at fair value $397,671,702 (98.9927%; self-custodied by Anchorage in segregated wallets — Solana $172,726,853, BSC $110,765,307, Avalanche $114,179,542) and cash $4,046,430 (1.0073%; demand deposit accounts at FDIC-insured depository institutions, held directly, United States, of which $3,796,430 exceeded the FDIC insurance limit). The examination classifies the entire non-BUIDL balance as FDIC-insured bank demand deposits, so the prior 'Assets in motion (settlement float)' unknown-counterparty slice is reclassified to the examined bank-deposit category with an immediate liquidity horizon; the live endpoint continues to label this balance 'assets in motion' (the source key is unchanged so V9 keeps classifying live rows), and the prior non-link disposition and 1.2% known-unknown are resolved by this disclosure. compositionAsOf equals the examination period end, so the curated rows are the independently examined fallback composition; the 2026-08-08 pass deliberately omitted the date because its weights tracked the rolling live endpoint rather than the examined balance-sheet date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte & Touche LLP examination of the USDtb Reserve Report as of July 31, 2026 (Schedule II composition of reserve assets by asset type), mapped onto the usdtb-transparency adapter's two slice identities
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All examined reserve assets are classified (BUIDL fund shares at fair value; FDIC-insured bank demand deposits). Individual deposit bank names are not disclosed, and BUIDL's own underlying fund holdings are governed by BlackRock's separate fund disclosures rather than this examination.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Anchorage reports that BUIDL is self-custodied in segregated wallets and cash is held in segregated fiduciary trust accounts at major commercial banks. The banks are not identified, current provider allocations can change, and the legal treatment has not been independently adjudicated.
